Hello Isakau,

Apologies for the delayed response.

Yes, we can arrange this for you. You can book Laya Mansion from 30th September to 9th October, and then Binghatti Amber from 9th to 30th October.

Please note that the October rate for Binghatti Amber is different. If you are okay with this arrangement, please let us know and I will share the rate breakdown with you.

Thank you.
